flags.why: The genus identification is wrong: diều hâu specifically names the black kite, Milvus migrans ([IUCN identification guide](https://portals.iucn.org/library/sites/library/files/documents/2009-101.pdf)).
Tốc hành is not an established interjection meaning “hurry up!”.

Trọng tải refers to a transport vehicle's carrying capacity, not a bridge's load capacity ([terminology discussion](https://www.khcn.vimaru.edu.vn/sites/khcn.vimaru.edu.vn/files/tap_chi_khcnhh_51-8-2017_final.pdf)).
flags.fix: carrying capacity; the maximum weight a vehicle or ship can carry

flags.why: The example incorrectly uses trọng tải for a bridge's capacity.
flags.fix: Chiếc xe tải này có trọng tải mười tấn. = This truck has a carrying capacity of ten tonnes.

flags.why: The entry omits the common classroom meaning of teaching or attending lessons ([dictionary entry](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-l%C3%AAn%20l%E1%BB%9Bp)).
flags.fix: to teach a class; to attend lessons in class
